# Design handoff — named journey/package

Set actual metadata and fidelity. State whether a Figma file exists and whether external edits are authorized. Link source commit, J/SCR/CMP/PRD/EVAL and token maturity. Remove prompts when used.

## Frame manifest

For each frame record stable ID/name, entry and exit, state owner, data provenance/sensitivity, exact copy, primary/secondary/escape controls, focus order/semantics, spoken/silent feedback, timeout/invalidation, loading/empty/error/Stop variants, orientation/scale and target next frames. Distinguish Android-owned placeholders from app UI.

## Interaction and visual review

Confirm touch/voice alternatives and consequence/partial-result comprehension. Identify neutral/candidate/selected/accepted values separately; no final name/logo/font assumed. Compare identities on identical structure and copy. Link actual measurements and leave user/device tests unrun until collected.

## Acceptance and engineering handoff

Coverage/missing variants, reviewer findings, open behavior and aesthetic questions, authorized source/asset references, token export status, affected contracts/evals, approval required and next bounded task. Visual polish is not behavior, safety or brand acceptance.
